This glitch effect is temporally tied to the narrative's climax, occurring precisely when a significant piece of evidence is revealed in the simulated program output.

statement: This sketch simulates a retro computer console displaying a detective story that unfolds through streaming text. The interface features cyan glowing text against a dark background, mimicking old terminal displays. As the narrative progresses, new lines of text appear automatically at regular intervals, creating an immersive storytelling experience. The key visual effect occurs during the story's climax when system messages flicker with glitch effects—simulating a computer malfunction that reveals crucial evidence. The sketch demonstrates temporal storytelling through text progression and dynamic visual feedback, creating an engaging simulation of a detective's investigation unfolding in real-time on screen.
